morphology.pattern_note: 借词整体作为词根记忆，保留起首辅音组合 /tr/；末尾 -i 属于词根，不是马来语后缀。

senses.zh_definition: 奖杯或其他具有纪念性质的实体奖品，授予比赛获胜者或取得优异成绩者。
senses.en_definition: A cup or other commemorative object awarded for victory or achievement in a competition.
senses.ms_definition: Hadiah seperti mangkuk perak atau piala yang dimenangi dalam pertandingan, misalnya pertandingan sukan.
senses.nuances: 强调作为获胜或成绩象征的实体奖品，范围可包括杯状、雕像状或其他造型；piala 常指杯形奖杯，也可用于赛事名称。奖金通常称 hadiah wang tunai，奖牌称 pingat。释义依据 [DBP《Kamus Dewan》第四版](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=trofi)。

dual_scenarios.context: 体育新闻 / 颁奖报道
dual_scenarios.ms: Kapten pasukan menjulang trofi selepas pasukannya menjuarai kejohanan tersebut.
dual_scenarios.zh: 球队夺得该项锦标赛冠军后，队长高举奖杯。
dual_scenarios.en: The team captain lifted the trophy after his team won the championship.

dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Kau dah ambil trofi tu ke?
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Adakah kamu sudah mengambil trofi itu?
dual_scenarios.zh: 你已经把那个奖杯领回来了吗？
dual_scenarios.en: Have you picked up the trophy yet?
spoken_features: 句末 ke 标记口语疑问

messages.speaker: Farah (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Kau dah ambil trofi tu ke? Nak tengok lah!
messages.ms_standard: Adakah kamu sudah mengambil trofi itu? Saya mahu melihatnya.
messages.zh: 你把那个奖杯领回来了吗？我想看看！
messages.en: Have you picked up the trophy yet? I want to see it!

messages.speaker: Amir (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Dah, ada kat rumah je. Nanti aku hantar gambar.
messages.ms_standard: Ya, saya sudah mengambilnya. Trofi itu ada di rumah. Nanti saya akan menghantar gambarnya.
messages.zh: 领了，就放在家里。等会儿我发照片给你。
messages.en: Yep, it's at home. I'll send you a photo later.

etymology.historical_story: Malay trofi corresponds to English trophy, whose history runs through French and Latin to Greek tropaion. Ancient trophies commemorated military victory and could consist of captured weapons displayed after battle. Modern competitions preserve the central idea of a visible victory memorial, replacing battlefield spoils with cups, sculptures, and other specially made awards. [Trophy word history](https://www.etymonline.com/word/trophy).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: trofi 和英语 trophy 几乎同音：看到 tro-fi，就想象冠军把奖杯高高举起。

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 祝贺获奖者可说 Tahniah atas kejayaan anda! 正式颁奖时按获奖者姓名、职衔或适当称谓介绍。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 适用于体育、学术、艺术和企业竞赛。谈论团队奖项时，承认队员和支持者的贡献通常比只突出个人更得体。
